noncomputable def VTask.prevFixed {α : Type u} [CompleteLattice α] (f : α →o α) (x : α) (hx : f x ≤ x) : ↑(Function.fixedPoints ⇑f) :=
let g := λ y : α, if y ≤ x then f y else ⊥
have hg : CompleteLattice g, from {
  ..inferInstance,
  le := λ y₁ y₂, λ h, if h then le_of_le_of_le (by simp only [if_pos]) (by simp only [if_neg]) h else bot_le,
  lt := λ y₁ y₂, λ h, if h then lt_of_lt_of_le (by simp only [if_pos]) (by simp only [if_neg]) h else false.elim,
  inf := λ y₁ y₂, if y₁ ≤ y₂ then f (inf y₁ y₂) else ⊥,
  sup := λ y₁ y₂, if y₁ ≤ y₂ then sup y₁ y₂ else ⊥,
  top := ⊥,
  bot := x,
}
have hf_g : OrderHom g f, from {
  toFun := g,
  homotone := λ y₁ y₂, λ h, if h then homotone_order_hom (by simp only [if_pos]) (by simp only [if_neg]) h else bot_le,
  map_id' := by simp only [if_pos],
  map_comp' := λ z w, by simp only [if_pos],
}
let z := Function.gfp hf_g
have hz : z ≤ x, from by simp only [if_pos]
have hzf : f z = z, from by simp only [if_pos]
have hfixed : z ∈ Function.fixedPoints f, from ⟨z, hzf⟩
hfixed
